source_strategy: Alif V1 preserved for head, face identity, bolts, zipper seam, suit shell, tie, and real suit tears. Arms and legs rebuilt to TSA anatomy lock.

tsa_locks.anatomy_rule: Arms must read as shoulder-upperarm-elbow-forearm-wrist-hand; legs must read as thigh-knee-calf-ankle-foot.
tsa_locks.face_rule: Eyes must read as embedded facial forms, not flat stickers.
tsa_locks.suit_damage_rule: All tears and holes in the black suit must be true cut-through geometry via boolean subtraction, never decal-like tempelan.
tsa_locks.tear_depth_rule: Inner green torso/body must remain visible behind openings so damage reads as cloth thickness + depth.
